concept:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high fidelity art direction contact sheet for a Chinese portrait mobile tower stacking arcade game called 都市摩天楼. Make one landscape image with EXACTLY SIX tall portrait game screens in a clean 3 columns x 2 rows grid with small gutters. This is a polished production concept, not a wireframe. All screens share the SAME toy architecture style, crisp editorial game UI, warm cream matte surfaces, midnight navy #17334D, cornflower blue glass #6EAAC4, construction saffron #F5BC51, small terracotta accents, very gentle ambient occlusion. Charming premium miniature city / architectural model style, clean low-detail plaster, perfectly sharp, no gritty textures, no realism. EACH portrait is 750:1334 aspect ratio. Important gameplay silhouette: stack of substantial rectangular cream building floors with navy framed tall blue windows, pale cornices, flat blue-gray roofs seen slightly from above. Each floor has same width. Golden crane at upper right suspends one identical floor; mostly empty sky around center for playable room. No isometric diamond blocks; front facing tower with shallow top view. Custom cream pill HUD: upper left tiny uppercase CONSTRUCTION plus Chinese title 都市摩天楼, 3 orange hearts; upper right navy round pause button. Bottom one cream elongated rounded bar, large navy floor count left, tiny skyline icon, center prompt 点击放下, large population right with tiny people icon. Small left-side vertical altitude ruler. Never place mock phone hardware or perspective tilted frames.
Panel 1 ground start: light turquoise gradient sky, subtle sun disk top left, little clouds, stylized miniature cream/blue terracotta city in bottom 25%, tree and road foundation, hanging cream floor center-upper, title readable.
Panel 2 cloud sea gameplay: 18 floors score, cream tower rises from bottom center, blue-white soft cloud layers off sides, tiny yellow hot air balloon, small navy pill 完美 ×3 with gold thin timer and pending +30. Golden star burst at top floor. Bottom HUD.
Panel 3 orbit gameplay: 86 floors score, deep navy-indigo gradient sky, luminous cyan thin atmospheric rim near bottom, elegant pale moon left, tiny satellite right, subtle small stars. Same tower, HUD, crane. Tiny gold pill 近地轨道.
Panel 4 pause overlay on ground gameplay: navy translucent scrim, centered cream dialog, tiny gold tower emblem, Chinese title 暂停施工, subtitle 大楼会停在这里, large saffron primary button 继续建造, navy outlined secondary 重新开始, text button 返回大厅. Simple clean hierarchy, lots of whitespace.
Panel 5 game over overlay at cloud level: same cream dialog, gold emblem, title 本次建造完成, small subtitle 每一层，都离星空更近, two pale statistic cells 28 楼层 and 460 人口, saffron primary 观看视频，继续建造 with video icon and small 3/3, bottom two outline buttons 再建一座 and 返回大厅.
Panel 6 deep space: 168 floors, dark navy purple gradient, desaturated rose ringed planet at right, distant turquoise planet left, pin point stars, same cream floor tower and golden crane, bottom cream HUD, same visual quality. Small gold milestone title 抵达深空.
Typography: clean bold rounded Chinese sans serif. UI precisely aligned to 28px inset. Restrained charm and excellent visual hierarchy. Use exact Chinese text where listed. No large decorative titles outside the 6 screens, no marketing poster, no watermarks, no logos of real games.
